title: Gold Plus Saver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: This document explains how Gold Plus Saver Account customers transfer funds to external banks, including typical timelines (standard transfers usually complete within 1 business day after initiation) and variability based on cutoffs/verification. It also covers outgoing domestic wire transfers ($10 fee per transfer), when to use wires vs standard transfers, and how to track transfers and contact support with a transfer reference if pending longer than expected.
faqs: How long do standard external bank transfers from my Gold Plus Saver Account take?
What fees apply to outgoing domestic wire transfers from this account?
When should I choose a standard external transfer versus an outgoing wire?
Where can I monitor a transfer’s status and what should I keep for reconciliation?
What should I do if my transfer stays pending beyond the expected timeframe?
